task_definition.task_description: Please check whether my investment account is active, then look up the current BTC price and send me an app alert that the crypto price check is done and the smart-light routine is starting. After that, find the light in my living room, identify the smart light device, check its current status, turn it on to 65% brightness with a warm white color, and then get the current time in New York.

user_input.query: Please check whether my investment account for user_01 is active, then look up the current price of BTC and send me an app alert saying, "Crypto price check completed and smart-light routine is starting." After that, find the light in my living_room, identify the smart light device with ID light_living, check its current status, and turn it on to 65% brightness with a warm_white color. When that’s done, also tell me the current time in America/New_York.
